landing.badge: Built on Stellar · Soroban smart contracts
landing.heroTitle: Prove your liquidity is <1>locked</1> — without asking for trust
landing.heroDesc: StellarLock lets projects lock tokens and LP positions in immutable on-chain contracts, then share a public, verifiable page so their community knows they can't rug.
landing.problemTitle: Rug pulls happen when teams can pull liquidity. So remove the option.
landing.problemDesc: When liquidity and team tokens are locked in a contract no one can withdraw early, the single biggest rug-pull vector disappears. StellarLock makes that lock public and shareable.
landing.featureTokenDesc: Lock allocations with a fixed unlock date or a linear vesting schedule. Extend anytime — never shorten.
landing.featureLpDesc: Lock Aquarius and Soroswap pool shares so traders know the liquidity floor stays put.
landing.featureExplorerDesc: Every lock gets a shareable page showing amounts, beneficiaries, and unlock dates — verifiable by anyone.
landing.stepLockDesc: Connect your wallet, choose a token or LP position, set the amount and unlock date, and sign one transaction.
landing.stepEnforceDesc: The Soroban contract holds the funds. No one — not even you — can withdraw before the unlock timestamp.
landing.stepShareDesc: Drop your public explorer link in your README or Telegram. Your community verifies the lock themselves.
landing.ctaTitle: Earn your community's trust in one transaction
landing.ctaDesc: Lock your liquidity, share the proof, and let the chain speak for you.

canOnlyExtend.message: New date must be after the current unlock date.

nothingToRelease.title: Nothing to Release
nothingToRelease.message: There are no tokens available to release from the vesting schedule at this time.
nothingToRelease.recovery: Wait for the next vesting period or check the vesting schedule.

vestingEndBeforeStart.title: Invalid Vesting Schedule

tooFewBeneficiaries.title: Not Enough Beneficiaries
tooFewBeneficiaries.message: A split lock must have at least 2 beneficiaries.

tooManyBeneficiaries.title: Too Many Beneficiaries
tooManyBeneficiaries.message: A split lock cannot have more than 10 beneficiaries.
tooManyBeneficiaries.recovery: Reduce the number of beneficiaries to 10 or fewer.

sharesMustSum10000.title: Invalid Share Distribution
sharesMustSum10000.message: The beneficiary shares must sum to exactly 10,000 basis points (100%).
sharesMustSum10000.recovery: Adjust the shares so they total exactly 10,000 BPS.

rateLimitExceeded.title: Too Many Requests
rateLimitExceeded.message: You've exceeded the rate limit for creating locks. Please wait before creating another lock.
rateLimitExceeded.recovery: Wait a moment and try again.

lockDurationTooShort.title: Lock Duration Too Short
lockDurationTooShort.message: The unlock date is too close to the current time. A minimum lock duration is required.
lockDurationTooShort.recovery: Choose an unlock date at least 24 hours in the future.

extensionLimitExceeded.title: Extension Limit Exceeded
extensionLimitExceeded.message: This lock has already been extended the maximum number of times allowed.
extensionLimitExceeded.recovery: No further extensions are possible for this lock.

unlockTooSoon.title: Extension Too Short
unlockTooSoon.message: The new unlock date must be far enough past the current one to count as an extension.
unlockTooSoon.recovery: Choose a date further in the future.

extensionLimitReached.title: Extension Limit Reached
extensionLimitReached.message: This lock has already been extended the maximum number of times allowed.
extensionLimitReached.recovery: No further extensions are possible for this lock.

unlockExceedsMax.title: Extension Too Long
unlockExceedsMax.message: The new unlock date is further in the future than the contract allows.
unlockExceedsMax.recovery: Choose an earlier date within the allowed range.

insufficientBalance.title: Insufficient Balance
insufficientBalance.message: You don't have enough tokens to lock this amount.
insufficientBalance.recovery: Reduce the amount or add funds to your wallet.

lockDurationTooLong.title: Lock Duration Too Long
lockDurationTooLong.recovery: Choose an unlock date within 10 years from today.

stillLocked.title: Lock Not Expired
